Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_cmv varchar2(1);
 temp_count number;
 temp_system_label_decision varchar2(10);
 l_emergency varchar2(10) := 'N';

begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure; 

/* Code added to reprint second label for Autologous units, If BIO interdictions present
 then print BIO labels else prints the tested abo code, which is the system lebel decision
 in UNITS table */

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.donor_decision_code = 'S' then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions u, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'B' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'B')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code = :ctrl_blk_1.donor_decision_code
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate));

 if temp_count > 0
 then
 If :ctrl_blk_1.label_type='PCA' then 
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := '58';
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := 'Mb';
 END IF;
 else
 if :rh_label_flag = 'N'
 then
 -- this is a component without Rh
 if :ctrl_blk_1.system_label_decision in ('06','62')
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := '66';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.system_label_decision in ('17','73')
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := '77';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.system_label_decision in ('28','84')
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := '88';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.system_label_decision in ('51','95')
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := '55';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.system_label_decision in ('00')
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := '00';
 end if;
 else
 -- non CRYO/RPL/RPFF component
 :ctrl_blk_1.second_label := :ctrl_blk_1.system_label_decision;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 END IF; 


--
-- If label_type = PAD and label = 'Mf' then can only print OFF due to digitrax changes. -- TR 1219
--
IF :ctrl_blk_1.label_type = 'PAD' and :ctrl_blk_1.label = 'Mf' then
 show_error('4323');
 check_package_failure;
ELSE
 show_error('9200','Label will be printed');

 /* This condition was added by Edwin to incorporate the codabar reprinting on 09.27.01 */

:GLOBAL.donor_decision_code := :ctrl_blk_1.donor_decision_code;
:GLOBAL.Product_type := :ctrl_blk_1.product_type;

check_auto_dir_cross_allowed;--Tr 1207
 
IF :ctrl_blk_1.donor_decision_code = 'S' and (check_for_bio) and :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' THEN 
 :GLOBAL.identifier_code := 'AB';
END IF;

if :GLOBAL.code_scheme='C' then
 if :ctrl_blk_1.label = '71' then
 :GLOBAL.identifier_code := 'EM'; 
 else
 :GLOBAL.identifier_code := 'RG';
 end if;
end if;
 
 If :ctrl_blk_1.label_type='PCA' then -- For codabar
/* -- TR 1219 - Digitrax requires exp date
 if :ctrl_blk_1.exp is null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.exp := calc_exp_date(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, null, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, null); 
 end if;*/
 PRINT_LABEL_DIGI('PCA', :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :ctrl_blk_1.label, :ctrl_blk_1.exp, NULL); 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.donor_decision_code = 'S' 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.second_label is not null then
 PRINT_LABEL_DIGI('PCA', :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :ctrl_blk_1.second_label, :ctrl_blk_1.exp, NULL); 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id');
 END IF;
 Else -- For ISBT
 if check_for_emergency(:ctrl_blk_1.label) then
 l_emergency := 'Y';
 :GLOBAL.identifier_code := 'EM'; 
 else
 l_emergency := 'N'; 
 end if; 
 temp_cmv := check_cmv(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id);

-- TR 1214 - calculate expiry date only if the unit is from an INTERNAL contract

 IF :GLOBAL.contract_id = 'INTERNAL' then
 :ctrl_blk_1.exp := calc_exp_date(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, null, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, null);
 END IF; 

 If :ctrl_blk_1.label_type = 'PPD' then -- do not pass a system label decision as digitrax is not able to handle it
 PRINT_LABEL_DIGI_ISBT(:ctrl_blk_1.label_type, :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, null, :ctrl_blk_1.exp, temp_cmv,l_emergency,:global.chapter_id,null,null,null);
 synchronize;
 Else 
 PRINT_LABEL_DIGI_ISBT(:ctrl_blk_1.label_type, :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :ctrl_blk_1.label, :ctrl_blk_1.exp, temp_cmv,l_emergency,:global.chapter_id,null,null,null);
 synchronize;
 End if;
 End if;

 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 --If :ctrl_blk_1.label_type in ('OFF','PAD','PCA') then -- Commented by Kishore on 07/16/2013
 If :ctrl_blk_1.label_type in ('OFF', 'PAD', 'PCA', 'PFF') then -- Added by Kishore on 07/16/2013
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_abo_scan',navigable,property_true);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_abo_scan');
 Else
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_abo_scan',navigable,property_false);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_id');
 End If;

 check_mf_or_non_mf; 
 :ctrl_blk_1.display_label := 'Verify Label';
--
-- If AB product but has a Mb, Mq or md then the identifier code should be 'RG'
--
if :ctrl_blk_1.label in ('Mb', 'Mq', 'Md') then 
 :GLOBAL.identifier_code := 'RG';
end if;

END IF;-- for Mf and PAD combination 

 -- go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_unit_abo_scan');

end;

PROCEDURE Val_colldate_scan_code128_old(p_scan_colldate in varchar2,
 p_out_colldate out date) IS
BEGIN
 /* First two characters of expiry date bar code will be =* -
 The Scan will have 2359 Tagged on but this would have to be ignored
 Validate them and if OK then accept. */

 IF (substr(p_scan_colldate,1,2 ) != '=*' AND 
 NVL(length(p_scan_colldate), 0) != 8 AND
 ltrim(substr(p_scan_colldate,3,10),'0123456789') IS NOT NULL)
 OR (substr(p_scan_colldate,1,2 ) != '&*' AND 
 NVL(length(p_scan_colldate), 0) != 12 AND
 ltrim(substr(p_scan_colldate,3,10),'0123456789') IS NOT NULL) 
 THEN 
 clear_item;
 show_error('9745');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 if substr(p_scan_colldate,3,1) = '9'
 then
 p_out_colldate := to_date('1'||substr(p_scan_colldate,3,6),'YYYYDDD');
 else
 p_out_colldate := to_date('2'||substr(p_scan_colldate,3,6),'YYYYDDD');
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 clear_item;
 show_error('1170');
 check_package_failure;
END;

FUNCTION check_for_bio RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 temp_bio VARCHAR2(1);
 --
 -- This cursor checks is any unit level BIOs are present
 --
 cursor c10 is
 select inter_desc
 from unit_interdictions u, valid_interdictions_lab v
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.inter_code = v.inter_code and
 'B' = (select decode(count(*),0,v.inter_type,
 1,min(o.inter_type),'B')
 from valid_inter_overrides o
 where o.product_type = :GLOBAL.product_type
 and o.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and o.donor_decision_code =
 :GLOBAL.donor_decision_code
 and sysdate between o.eff_date
 and nvl(o.term_date,sysdate));
 --
 -- This cursor is used to check if the any profile test
 -- (required for labeling) has a NT result and does have
 -- any reactive result. This will throw a BIO interdiction.
 -- This check is redundant as it done by the core routine already.
 -- It can be removed if performance becomes a problem.
 --
 cursor c25 is
 select distinct test_id
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 result_status_2 is null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_1 = 'NT' and
 cancel_flag is null and
 exists (select 'x'
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = :GLOBAL.contract_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 contract_tests.test_id = utrs.test_id and
 stop_label_flag = 'Y' and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)) and
 exists (select 'x'
 from utrs u, master_codes
 where u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.test_id = utrs.test_id and
 u.result_status_2 is null and
 u.result_status_1 is not null and
 u.cancel_flag is null and
 code_type = 'REAC' and
 code = result_status_1 and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base u, master_codes
 where u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.test_id = utrs.test_id and
 u.result_status_2 is null and
 u.result_status_1 is not null and
 u.cancel_flag is null and
 code_type = 'REAC' and
 code = result_status_1 and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365))
 union
 select distinct test_id
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 result_status_2 is null and
 result_status_1 is not null and
 result_status_1 = 'NT' and
 cancel_flag is null and
 exists (select 'x'
 from contract_tests
 where contract_id = :GLOBAL.contract_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 contract_tests.test_id =
 unit_test_base.test_id and
 stop_label_flag = 'Y' and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)) and
 exists (select 'x'
 from utrs u, master_codes
 where u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.test_id = unit_test_base.test_id and
 u.result_status_2 is null and
 u.result_status_1 is not null and
 u.cancel_flag is null and
 code_type = 'REAC' and
 code = result_status_1 and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base u, master_codes
 where u.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(u.coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 u.test_id = unit_test_base.test_id and
 u.result_status_2 is null and
 u.result_status_1 is not null and
 u.cancel_flag is null and
 code_type = 'REAC' and
 code = result_status_1 and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
BEGIN
 
 --
 -- CHECK REASONS FOR BIO
 --
 temp_bio := 'N';
 --


 begin
 for c10_rec in c10
 loop
 temp_bio := 'Y';
 if c10%rowcount = 1 then
 null;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 --

 -- check if NT results with one REACTIVE result is present
 -- for profile tests required for labeling
 --
 begin
 for c25_rec in c25
 loop
 temp_bio := 'Y';
 if c25%rowcount = 1
 then
 null; 
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 --
 -- All checks for possible BIO are complete. BIO decision
 -- will now be displayed if any of the condition was true
 -- before. If the unit is AUTOLOGOUS, then checks for NFT will
 -- be made.
 --

 if temp_bio = 'Y'
 then
 return(TRUE);
 else
 return(FALSE); 
 end if;
RETURN NULL; 
END;
